newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan to import up to one mln kg Indian tea.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan to import up to one mln kg Indian tea.

text.p: Pakistani traders and tea blenders have placed import orders of up to a million kg of tea from neighbouring India, the private Tea Association of Pakistan (PTA) said on Thursday.

It said the deals, the first major ones after a gap of about seven years, were made during a two-day visit this week by a 13-member delegation of the Indian Tea Board to Pakistan's commercial capital of Karachi.

"Our traders and blenders booked an approximate one million kilos of tea with Indian exporters and producers," a PTA official told Reuters. He said the deals, mostly for varieties grown in India's northeastern Assam region, were for shipment in August-October.
"The talks were good and we hope as trade relations between India and Pakistan improve more Pakistani traders would go for Indian grades," he said.

Abdul Waheed Khawaja, a former PTA chairman, said the Indian delegation's visit was well-timed as tea prices in Kenya, Pakistan's main source of tea imports, had risen very sharply during the past few weeks.
